questions.question: Solve $x^{3}-2x-5=0$ by Newton's-Raphson method correct to three decimal places, starting with $x_{0}=2$.
questions.knowledgeNote: Stop Newton-Raphson only when two successive approximations agree to the required number of decimal places.
